units.time: real seconds unless the name says game_minutes or game_hours
units.clock_note: 1 game minute = 2 real seconds; 1 game hour = 120 real seconds; 48 real minutes a game day

open_points: FIT-G5 on edge for Mickey's door passes only with a chosen sight rule: the door counts as in sight within 10 m of Quay Street's foot on the quay road. With 6 m the gap is 122 s against 120. The numbers are in sight_checks.
FIT-G3 out and back is 30 game minutes = 60 real seconds on the 120 s hour (30 s on the old hour). DATA-SWEEP.csv says 15 s: wrong; 60 s used.
2.6.5 says a manhunt sign shows one game hour (60 real seconds): 120 real seconds on the 120 s hour; used.
2.6.5 says Ellis comes for talk from the second day; the prototype says day 4. Blueprint (day 2) used.
A night is 960 real seconds, about 2.3 beat cycles of 7 real minutes.
DS Ellis can be bought (24 Nov); overrides 4.3.7 and 2.6.8, which the keeper must change.

Bought officers act once each (blueprint); the prototype let the look-away man act 99 times and priced the statement man at 150; blueprint and economy used. Officers are roles with person_ref; the cast comes from the story.
Custody: 6 hours for a window and also for a plain assault (no source); gun possession 12 hours is chosen to match RT2-17.

Response times per deed are game minutes chosen from the prototype's one 20-minute figure; 2.6.10 is pending. Gun calls: the first unarmed officer comes at the ordinary time, armed men at 45 game minutes at Fired and 10 at War.
Search length 30 to 120 real seconds is from 2.6.10; DEFINITIONS marks it PENDING.
Three cars at War (one armed) so both War stops are manned 18:00 to 02:00; 2.6.6/2.6.7 say only 'at least one armed car' and 'more only at War'.
G4's constable run speed 5.2 m/s is PENDING on footage (prototype 4.2).
Ellis case points use the economy run's scale (stage up at 4, 8, 12; arrest at 8), which is not the same thing as the charges list; the build must map one to the other.

beat_constable.note_speed: G4 (1.1 walk, 5.2 run) is newer than the prototype (1.5 walk, 4.2 run) and wins; G4 is PENDING on footage

second_constable.offset_rule: half a cycle behind on the same route

sight_checks.method: walked from the node path at 0.25 s steps; sight windows are chosen: Mickey's door in sight on Quay Street and within 10 m of its foot on the quay road (chosen rule, was 6 m; with it the on-edge door gap passes); the yards' lane in sight on the lane, its two ends and within 8 m of its foot; the landing within 20 m of the landing node

rattled_bin.rule: a rattled bin (the noise rule) moves him off the beat: he walks the shortest way to the bin, looks about 8 s (chosen), walks back to the node he left and rejoins the timetable from there, his phase shifted by the time away

bought.pay_day: every seventh game day from the day she was bought
